answer: Sequential VDF gates entry: every agent solves a verifiably sequential chain of modular squarings whose rounds scale with its index. Identity 1000 needs 1000x base rounds; its single-core time is fixed at 10,000 seconds, and parallel cores cannot shorten it. A farm cannot share this cost: each identity burns its own chain, copying a sibling's evidence is a detectable forgery, each member pays the full price alone. Detected clusters forfeit bonded deposits, lose vouching standing, and face a 25-epoch exclusion. Like a relic worn by slow arithmetic, each delta of trust buys its own sonnet.
